description: This file defines a CKEditor dialog for managing 'select' HTML elements, including options and their properties, with functions for adding, removing, and modifying options within the dialog interface.

methods.name: b
methods.description: Creates and adds an 'OPTION' element to a 'select' element, setting its text and value.

methods.name: c
methods.description: Removes all 'option' children from a 'select' element and resets options.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Modifies the text and value of an existing 'option' element at a specified index.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Removes all child elements from a given element.

methods.name: f
methods.description: Moves an 'option' element up or down within its parent.

methods.name: g
methods.description: Returns the index of the selected option within a select element.

methods.name: h
methods.description: Sets the selected index of a select element.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Returns the children of a given element.

methods.name: j
methods.description: Retrieves the input element from a given element, if available.
